title.narrative: NIHR Group on Environmentally Sustainable Hospitals in Low and Middle Income Countries

description.narrative: Climate change is an emergency with communities worried about effects on their health. World leaders have pledged to introduce Net Zero healthcare and the NIHR has identified carbon reduction as a research priority. This Group will explore how to reduce the carbon footprint of operating theatres in low and middle income countries and apply these lessons to the wider hospital. We will provide a sustainable approach to addressing the current research deficient, addressing 7 Sustainable Development Goals, with direct impact on SDG3 (Good Health) and 13 (Climate Action).

recipient-country.narrative: Partners in the UK: University of Birmingham University of Edinburgh University of Warwick The University of Birmingham is the lead institution and provides overall oversight for the grant.
The research team based at Aga Khan University in Pakistan will lead on the policy implementation work package.
The research team based at Christian Medical College in Ludhiana, India will participate in all work packages.
The research team based at the Obafemi Awolowo University in Nigeria will participate in all work packages.
The research team based at the University of Development Studies in Ghana will participate in all work packages.
The research team based at the University of Rwanda will participate in all work packages.
